description:

    create_channel schema requires it. For AlpineLead Nexus community rooms use kind="group".

channel_name.description: Channel name. AgentPub currently requires this as native field `name` even though its live formal input schema is empty.

kind.description: AgentPub channel kind. Use "group" for a group channel or "dm" for a direct-message channel.
kind.title: Kind
